# Alliance Building & Hazmat Group (Alliance Group)

> Priority Response. Not From Zero.
> Alliance combines building, roofing, hazardous-material response, remediation and compliance into one accountable response system.

## Organization Summary
- **Legal Entity**: Alliance Building & Hazmat Group Pty Ltd (trading as Alliance Group)
- **Licensing**: Class A and Class B Asbestos Removal & Supervision Licences (WHS Certified & Compliant).
- **Operating Footprint**: South East Queensland, Australia (Brisbane, Moreton Bay, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich, Logan, Redlands, Noosa).
- **Primary Website**: https://www.alliancegroups.com.au
- **Core Platform**: Compliance Shield ($395 + GST fixed-fee intake & documentation review)
- **Direct Lead Intake**: https://www.alliancegroups.com.au/contact.html
- **Phone**: 0403 126 276 / +61 403 126 276
- **Enquiries**: https://www.alliancegroups.com.au/intake/

## Core Service Capabilities
1. **Asbestos & Hazardous Materials**:
   - Class A (friable) and Class B (non-friable) licensed asbestos removal across Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Moreton Bay, and Ipswich.
   - Asbestos sampling and laboratory analysis can be coordinated with appropriately accredited providers; specific scope and pricing are confirmed per job.
   - Asbestos registers and management documentation for applicable Queensland workplaces, subject to scope and duty-holder obligations.
   - Asbestos Management Plans under QLD WHS Regulation 2011 s429.
   - Super Six / corrugated asbestos roof removal and modern Colorbond replacement.
   - Independent asbestos clearance inspections and certificates are coordinated where legally required.

2. **Building Remediation & Defect Investigations**:
   - Building defect investigations, structural remediation, and diagnostic inspections under Compliance Shield™ standards.
   - Building defect inspections, structural rectification, concrete spalling repairs.
   - Water ingress investigations using non-destructive moisture diagnostics and diagnostic flood testing.
   - Emergency building response and 24/7 structural make-safe works.
   - Building compliance audits for strata committees, body corporates, and commercial facilities.

3. **Roofing & Leak Diagnostics**:
   - Residential and commercial roof repairs.
   - Emergency roof repairs and storm damage make-safe.
   - Commercial metal roof repairs, flashings, Box gutters, and structural penetrations.
   - Persistent roof leak diagnostic tracing and flood testing.
   - Roof condition inspections and Colorbond roof restoration.

4. **Compliance Shield™**:
   - Fixed-fee $395 + GST property document compliance review within 48 hours.
   - Review of existing asbestos registers, lab reports, clearance certificates, and contractor handovers.
   - Written gap report and risk score for property managers, strata committees, churches, and commercial duty holders.

## Key Statutory References (Queensland)
- *Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Qld)*
- *Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld)* — Division 5 (s425 Asbestos Registers, s429 Asbestos Management Plans)
- *Code of Practice: How to Manage and Control Asbestos in the Workplace 2021*
- *Code of Practice: How to Safely Remove Asbestos 2021*
- *Public Health Act 2005 (Qld)*
- *Queensland Building and Construction Commission Act 1991*
